Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection

Class Protections

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.Protections
public final class Protections extends Object
The permission checks a vanilla bucket applies before it changes the world, plus the registry of claim-protection providers those checks consult.

The block-use packet path gates on Level.mayInteract(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos) before an item ever sees it, so this exists for the operations driven from Item.use, which the server receives without a target position.

Providers are composed by unanimous consent: the first denial vetoes the action and prevents later providers and the mod-owned mutation from running. Registration occurs during mod setup and interaction-time reads occur on the server thread; the registry is intentionally not safe for concurrent registration and lookup. Loader-specific optional-integration bootstrap (deciding which providers to register) is not this class's job; each loader entrypoint calls register(com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.ClaimProtectionProvider) directly for whatever optional integrations it finds loaded.

  • Method Details

    • mayAct

      public static boolean mayAct(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, ProtectionContext context, ProtectionAction action, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, net.minecraft.core.Direction face, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, @Nullable net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity targetEntity)
      Applies vanilla player restrictions and every registered claim provider to one exact action and target.

      The vanilla Level.mayInteract(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos) spawn-protection and world-border gate is applied to every player action, including ProtectionAction.ENTITY_INTERACT, at the target entity's own position. The stricter Player.mayUseItemAt(net.minecraft.core.BlockPos, net.minecraft.core.Direction, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack) block-placement gate is skipped for ENTITY_INTERACT, since interacting with a mob neither places nor breaks a block. Claim providers receive every action, including automation contexts and the dispenser's source block.

      Parameters:
      level - level the action applies in
      context - acting player and hand, dispenser source, or explicit unowned automation
      action - kind of mutation or interaction being authorized
      pos - exact block position associated with the action
      face - face or direction associated with the action
      stack - bucket stack driving the action
      targetEntity - entity being interacted with or released, or null when the action has no entity target
      Returns:
      true when every gate and provider allows the action, false on the first denial

    • register

      public static Protections.Registration register(ClaimProtectionProvider provider)
      Registers provider until the returned token is closed.

      The caller must register and close the token on the same single-threaded lifecycle assumed by interaction handling; closing is idempotent with respect to provider presence.

      Parameters:
      provider - provider to append to the authorization chain
      Returns:
      lifetime token whose Protections.Registration.close() method unregisters the provider
